clips.title: The story
paras: In Northshire Valley's northwestern cliffs, Echo Ridge Mine lies rich in stone and ore, but kobolds have seized it.

Echo Ridge Mine was cut into the hills above Northshire Abbey to supply the valley with stone and metal. Kobolds poured through its tunnels and drove out the workers. Marshal McBride sees them as a danger to Northshire's safety and its recruits. He sends new recruits into the mine to thin their numbers and take the site back.
Kobolds have been pushing into Elwynn Forest beyond Echo Ridge Mine. From the northwestern ridge, they threaten Northshire's training grounds and the flow of resources to the abbey.
